description: Manage files and folders, inspect revisions and checksums, and watch folder contents for changes.

pcloud_new_file_or_folder_trigger.description: Runs for each new file or folder directly inside the selected folder. Existing items establish a baseline. Files created and deleted between checks cannot be recovered. Checks follow your workspace plan.

pcloud_new_or_updated_file_or_folder_tri.description: Runs for each new or changed file or folder directly inside the selected folder. Existing items establish a baseline. Files created and deleted between checks cannot be recovered. Checks follow your workspace plan.
pcloud_new_or_updated_file_or_folder_tri.display_name: New or updated file or folder
